note: Vanuatu: nationals of the countries listed enter without a visa for up to 120 days; everyone else applies for an e-Visa (a visitor visa of up to 30 days, or a pre-approved tourist visa: taken as an e-Visa without a fixed stay). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.said: obtain an e-Visa unless they are citizens of one of the visa-exempt countries. ... Citizens of the following countries and territories may enter Vanuatu without a visa for up to 120 days: All European Union member states Andorra Antigua and Barbuda Argentina Australia Azerbaijan Bahamas Bahrain Bangladesh Barbados Belarus Belize Botswana Brazil Brunei Cameroon Canada Chile China Cuba Dominica Eswatini Fiji Gambia Ghana Grenada Guyana Hong Kong India Israel Jamaica Japan Kenya Kiribati Kuwait Lesotho Liechtenstein Macau Malawi Malaysia Maldives Marshall Islands Mauritius Mexico Micronesia Morocco Mozambique Namibia Nauru New Zealand Nigeria Norway Oman Pakistan Palau Papua New Guinea Peru Philippines Qatar Rwanda Russia Saint Kitts and Nevis Saint Lucia Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Samoa San Marino Saudi Arabia Serbia Seychelles Sierra Leone Singapore Solomon Islands South Africa South Korea Sri Lanka Switzerland Taiwan Tanzania Thailand Tonga Trinidad and Tobago Tunisia Turkey Tuvalu Uganda Ukraine United Arab Emirates United Kingdom United States Uruguay Vatican City Zambia Zimbabwe ... Citizens of countries that require a visa may obtain an e-Visa.
